mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current FEDFUNDS level of 3.04% is below 3.5%, so positive returns are predicted.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 5.5% (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The current UNRATE is 5.0%, so a rise above 5.5% activates the signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.
